title: paraboea multiflora var. burmanica

It is a perennial herb that is native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Burman's Paraboea include its potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being.
